feeds.title: Knit and Stitch Blog by Black sheep wools
feeds.description: Established in 1983, Black Sheep Wools is a family run knitting & needlecraft retailer, based in the village of Culcheth, Warrington, Cheshire. We pride ourselves on stocking all the major brands that knitters & stitchers love at fabulously low prices. Buy knitting and crochet yarn, patterns knitting needles, crochet hooks, needlecraft, fabric & more from Black Sheep Wools: The UK's top retailer for craft supplies.

feeds.title: Kate Davies Designs
feeds.description: You can read pieces exploring a wide range of topics in textile history and design from Kate, and enjoy recipes photography and tutorials from Tom. My name is Kate Davies. I live by Scotland's West Highland Way where I love writing knitting, and walking in the wonderful landscapes that surround me. I began Kate Davies Designs (KDD) creating digital patterns for hand knitters.

feeds.title: Pom Pom Quarterly Blog
feeds.description: We bring you more thoughtful, beautiful, joyful, educational, and inspirational knitted and crocheted! We share knitting patterns with a modern aesthetic, great photos and interesting writing!

feeds.title: Janie Crow Blog
feeds.description: We aspire to give knitters and crocheters a range of exciting project designs and products which are not available elsewhere. Designer Jane Crowfoot specialises in designs for the home interior - including cushions and throws and regularly teaches workshops to pass on her passion for the crafts of knit and crochet.

feeds.title: Loop Knit lounge
feeds.description: Loop is like being at the best yarn fair in the world with brilliant and warm staff to help you. We have a huge selection of natural hand-dyed yarns as well as the basics. We're the European flagship shop for both Brooklyn Tweed and Quince & Co and we also stock Wollmeise and Woolfolk yarns as well as over 100 colours of Madelinetosh. We have a brilliant selection of haberdashery and publications as well as a huge range of classes from beginners to master classes with visiting teachers.

feeds.title: The Twisted Yarn
feeds.description: Hello, and welcome. I'm Phil. Here is my blog, all about knitting and crocheting color into my home in the Oxfordshire countryside. When I'm not busy with yarn, I'm a clinical psychologist and mother of small twins. I also write a quarterly column for Simply Knitting magazine.

feeds.title: Emma Varnam's Blog
feeds.description: For nearly ten years I have had a successful crochet and knitting design career. I enjoy balancing my daily need to be creative with sharing my experiences and inspiration on this blog. I have designed both knitting and crochet designs for magazines including; Knitting Magazine, Debbie Bliss Magazine, Let's Get Crafting, Simply Crochet, Inside Crochet and Crochet Now.

feeds.title: Curious Handmade
feeds.description: Delightful knitting patterns and creativity. Making things is good for the soul.

feeds.title: Planet Penny
feeds.description: Crafts, Needle Felting, Crochet, Patterns & Tutorials.

feeds.title: The Knit with attitude Blog
feeds.description: This is the Knit with attitude blog, but be prepared for some personal views, opinions and musings as well. Welcome to The world according to MayaB.

feeds.title: Shortrounds
feeds.description: Shortrounds is where I share my original knitwear designs, knitting patterns and the knitters and knitwear that inspire me in handmade crafts.

feeds.title: UK hand Knitting Association
feeds.description: The Knitty-pedia of all things Hand Knitting and Crochet.

feeds.title: Knit With Hannah Blog
feeds.description: learning to knit without stumbling along the way.

feeds.title: Miss Lavenders Blog
feeds.description: Keep up with articles from Miss Lavenders.

feeds.title: Tea Cosy Folk Designs
feeds.description: TeaCosyFolk design unique novelty tea cosy knitting patterns for you to make your own characterful tea cosies - perfect tea party talking points! Get exciting designs of tea cosies that are beautiful, funny, adorable and always eye popping!

feeds.title: The Knitting Network | Home to Woman's Weekly exclusive patterns
feeds.description: Discover the best Knitting and Crochet Patterns, Yarn, Needles, Books & Accessories. Spend over £25 & get free UK delivery with The Knitting Network.

feeds.title: Mad Man Knitting
feeds.description: Gregory Patrick is an author and knitter who began his knitting career after becoming homeless in 2011, knitting teddy bears in order to raise money for food and eventually a place to live. He currently lives in Orlando, FL with his husband, Phillip.

feeds.title: Hand Knitted Things
feeds.description: Hand Knitted Things and other things that catch my eye. Julia started her blog Hand Knitted Things in 2008 as a way of documenting her knitting projects and sharing them with others.

feeds.title: The Woolly Adventures of a Knitting Kitty
feeds.description: My spare time is filled with knitting, spinning, crochet and sewing. I hope you enjoy reading about the goings on chez josiekitten!

feeds.title: Confessions of a YarnAddict
feeds.description: I'm one of the UK's leading knitting designers & teach workshops around the UK. Workshops - Designs - Kits - Yarn - Retreats Author of Beaded Lace Knitting

feeds.title: A Kingfisher Morning
feeds.description: Mad knitter and writer Juliet Bernard share her latest adventures in Knitting and creating picturesque crochet designs. Follow A Kingfisher Morning to catch up with her new projects, design ideas, personal updates, and more.

feeds.title: Mostly knitting Blog
feeds.description: I'm a knitter. I love to read and write and daydream. I live at the top of a hill in a little village and I work for the Church, although I only write about it here in so far as it impinges on my knitting.

feeds.title: Linda Whaley knitting patterns Blog
feeds.description: Contemporary and stylish knitting patterns for babies and children, created by UK knitwear designer Linda Whaley. Start knitting today with all patterns available to download instantly.

feeds.title: CoopKnits Blog
feeds.description: Knitwear designer with a focus on small and intricate pieces that are both beautiful and functional.

feeds.title: Little Cotton Rabbits
feeds.description: knitting like mad and living with autism in the family. Knitting patterns for toys and novelties, some free and some to buy.

feeds.title: Winwick Mum
feeds.description: An award-winning creative lifestyle blog featuring the hugely popular free Sockalong sock-knitting tutorials for beginners - let the fun begin! I'm Christine. I live in Winwick, a small village in Cheshire, and this is where I write about what makes me happy: my family, knitting, gardening, home-making, enjoying the outdoors.

feeds.title: Woolly Wormhead Blog
feeds.description: My name is Woolly Wormhead and I am a Hat architect.Hats are fascinating. They are relatively quick to knit, but they are also endlessly versatile. I think of my Hat designs as sculptures and 3D objects. I build them in my head, then construct them with my hands. Unique & original woolly Hat designs. Knitting & crochet patterns, techniques & tutorials, all available in PDF format for immediate download.

feeds.title: YAK Yarn and Knitting Blog
feeds.description: YAK is the hub of the knitting and crochet community online and in Brighton. All things yarn and knitting are our forte and we are here to keep you up to date with the most beautiful hand dyed yarns, the latest patterns and the most exciting innovative tools on the market.

feeds.title: The penguin with the pointy sticks
feeds.description: Knitting and fencing but not always together. I'm a fencer who knits or possibly a knitter who fences. But both clear my head to think about media development keeping pace with all the new channels to our audiences.

feeds.title: The Wool Nest Blog
feeds.description: My name is Lynne Rowe and I'm a knit and crochet fanatic. I can't imagine a day without picking up my needles or hook and creating something fab and funky. I design for many UK knitting magazines and publications, including Let's Knit, Let's Get Crafting, Knit Today, Inside Crochet, Woman's Weekly and Homemaker. I also teach knit and crochet locally in Cheshire.
